origin.rerun: grep -n 'tar xzf /tmp/payload/landing.tgz' .github/workflows/research-queue-dispatch.yml  # present = the whole-file restore still exists

what: research-queue-dispatch `land` job restores the dispatch job's WHOLE research/queue/*.yaml files with `tar xzf landing.tgz` over a checkout that can be newer than the one the dispatcher read (gap ~3 min, observed run 38379540767: dispatch checkout 09:53Z, land checkout 09:55Z). Any queue-unit edit merged in that gap (a re-arm, a hand edit) is overwritten wholesale by the stamp PR. NOT the cause of the #17853 incident (that was stranded-stamp adoption, fixed by #17879) but the same failure class and still latent. Fix: carry the base stamp value in the payload and apply stamps in the land job by compare-and-set (write last_dispatched_at only if the current file still holds the value the dispatcher read), tested like tests/test_commit_to_main_stamp_race.py.
